episodes.title: The Eccentric Driver
episodes.summary: It's business as usual for privately-owned taxi driver Odokawa as he drives a variety of passengers around the city. He also pays a visit to his doctor.

episodes.title: How to Spend a Long Night
episodes.summary: It's business as usual for privately-owned taxi driver Odokawa as he drives a variety of passengers around the city. He also visits the sauna.

episodes.title: Borrowed Plumes and the Bodyguard
episodes.summary: It's business as usual for privately-owned taxi driver Odokawa as he drives a variety of passengers around the city. He also has a wanted criminal armed with a gun get into his taxi.

episodes.title: Tanaka's Revolution
episodes.summary: It's business as usual for privately-owned taxi driver Odokawa as he drives a variety of passengers around the city. Sometimes he drives in a little bit of a hurry.

episodes.title: Don't Call Me an Idol
episodes.summary: It's business as usual for privately-owned taxi driver Odokawa as he drives a variety of passengers around the city. Sometimes idols ride in his taxi, but don't worry; he's as tight-lipped as an authentic bartender.

episodes.title: Let Me Hear You Say, "What the Hell?
episodes.summary: It's business as usual for privately-owned taxi driver Odokawa as he drives a variety of passengers around the city. Sometimes he's taken to a cabaret club in Shinjuku.

episodes.title: Trick or Treat
episodes.summary: It's business as usual for privately-owned taxi driver Odokawa as he drives a variety of passengers around the city. Sometimes weirdos pick fights with him in Shibuya on Halloween.

episodes.title: Bless You
episodes.summary: It's business as usual for privately-owned taxi driver Odokawa as he drives a variety of passengers around the city. Come to think of it, he's driven Goriki before.

episodes.title: The Hero's Melancholy
episodes.summary: It's business as usual for privately-owned taxi driver Odokawa as he drives a variety of passengers around the city. However, he's not very good at car chases.

episodes.title: We Have No Tomorrow
episodes.summary: It's business as usual for privately-owned taxi driver Odokawa as he drives a variety of passengers around the city. Sometimes he's threatened and attacked by passengers.

episodes.title: If We Could Go Back to That Day
episodes.summary: It's business as usual for privately-owned taxi driver Odokawa as he drives a variety of passengers around the city. Due to his profession, he's familiar with the parking lots around the city.

episodes.title: Not Enough
episodes.summary: It's business as usual for privately-owned taxi driver Odokawa as he drives a variety of passengers around the city. Sometimes he helps rob a bank.

episodes.summary: It's business as usual for privately-owned taxi driver Odokawa as he drives a variety of passengers around the city.
